excerpts.label: Software industrial complex—loser
excerpts.insight: $3-4T/year in maintenance/migration revenue will shrink. AI agents disrupting 90% of enterprise software spend.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT legacy SaaS—ServiceNow, Workday, DocuSign. Per-seat model broken. Maintenance being automated.

excerpts.label: Jevons paradox—AI creates jobs
excerpts.insight: AI will increase knowledge worker demand. As code generation cost falls, more software created. Radiologists up despite AI because more scans.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Don't bet on AI job destruction. Jevons paradox = lower cost = more use cases = more demand.
